hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) pnpm exec oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; true

output=$(pnpm check 2>&1); exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then printf "%s" "$output" | jq -Rs '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("pnpm check failed:\n" + .)}}'; exit 2; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"pnpm check: no type errors"}}'; fi

output=$(pnpm lint 2>&1); exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then printf "%s" "$output" | jq -Rs '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("pnpm lint failed:\n" + .)}}'; exit 2; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"pnpm lint: no issues"}}'; fi
